description: Utorda beach lies to the north of the famous Majorda beach. The beach is palm-lined with a strip of white sands sloping gently into the Arabian sea. Situated in South Goa, Utorda Beach is popular as one of the cleanest, most gorgeous beachside in the area. One of the lesser-known beachfront, Utorda is visited by a selective number of tourists every year who come to the location to unwind and energize themselves. The fastest way to get to Utorda beach from Panaji is to rent a taxi or to drive a car within a distance of 28 km, and also from Goa International Airport. Though renting a taxi could be more expensive than driving your own car, both would take around 45 minutes to reach. you can also take a bus from the Panjim KTC bus stand to Utorda. The journey takes around a couple of hours but is the cheapest option. The best time to Visit Utorda beach is during the peak season i.e. from November to March. The weather is cooler during these months and the entire area is dotted with vibrancy. There are some activities available at Utorda beach, Water skiing, Windsurfing, and fishing trips, A fishing trip at Utorda beach brings you a chance to indulge in this laid-back activity and experience the Goan way of living. There are quite a few shacks at this beach to relax. Some of them are, Seashell Beach Shack located right on the beach, this shack is perfect for you to chill for the whole day. As It provides free chairs and sun loungers for its guests to relax and enjoy the surroundings. If you want to enjoy Indian as well as international cuisines, there are some popular places to eat near beach-like Balton’s, The palms, and Zeebop by Sea. there is also quite a range of accommodations available near Utorda beach, budget-friendly to luxuries. the shores of Utorda beach are swarmed with local shops and hawkers selling a wide range of products. Some of the things you can expect to find here are beach clothing, trinkets, and handicrafts. Some places to visit around Utorda Beach: 1. Majorda Beach Situated halfway between Utorda beach and Betalbatim beach, Majorda is considered to be one of the most gorgeous beach shores in Goa. 2. Three Kings Chapel Host of the ‘Feast of Three Kings’ festival celebrated on the 6th of January each year, Three Kings Chapel is one of the hidden gems of Utorda beach. How To Reach Utorda Beach By Air One of the most convenient methods of getting to Utorda beach By making your flight reservations to Goa. The closest and most important airport for the city is Dabolim Airport, also known as Goa International Airport. The travel time from the Goa airport to Utorda beach is roughly 30 minutes and the distance is 15.1 kilometers. To get to Utorda Beach immediately from the airport, use a taxi, cab, or auto-rickshaw. How To Reach Utorda Beach By Road Using any form of road transportation is an additional way to get to the Utorda Beach area. Buses to Utorda Beach Goa are run by a number of public and commercial interstate bus companies out of Pune, Mumbai, and Delhi. Other than that, the state highways and roads going to Utorda Beach are in decent shape if you decide for self-driving or a taxi. How To Reach Utorda Beach By Rail Cansaulim (3.8 km) and Majorda Junction (3.3 km) are the two closest railway stations to Utorda Beach. Besides than these two, the two other major rail hubs are Madgaon and Vasco-da-Gama. At the train station, you can find taxis, cabs, or auto-rickshaws that will take you directly to Utorda Beach. How To Reach Beach From Panaji Taking a taxi or bus from Panaji to Utorda Beach South Goa is one of the best ways to get there. The drive from Panaji to Utorda Beach is approximately 28.9 kilometres, and it will take an hour to complete the trip. The greatest alternative out of all the ones offered would be to take a bus to Utorda Beach from the Panaji bus stop. It is a practical and accessible way to get to Utorda Beach. Best Time To Visit Utorda Beach Like any other beach in Goa, Utorda Beach also enjoys a slightly warm and cold breezy climate. So the best time to visit Utorda Beach is between November to March, which is the winter season. During this particular time period, the temperature ranges between 20 degrees Celsius to 30 degrees Celsius, making the climatic conditions quite pleasant and perfect for all the activities. Whether you want to indulge in some Utorda Beach water sports or just want to sit back and relax in the sun, this is the perfect time to enjoy it all.

Renting a scooter is one of the best ways to explore Utorda Beach. But, keep your driver's license close by.
Always stay hydrated, and if you can, always have a water bottle with you.
As Utorda Beach is renowned for its cleanliness, it is recommended to preserve the beach's appearance and bring back all of your rubbish in a plastic bag.
